name: plain
sql: SELECT id FROM orders

name: ordered-limit
sql: SELECT id FROM orders ORDER BY id LIMIT 10

name: nullable
sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status IS NULL

name: literal-dml
sql: SELECT 'DELETE FROM orders' FROM orders

name: quoted
sql: SELECT `id` FROM `orders`

name: join
sql: SELECT o.id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.user_id

name: left-join
sql: SELECT o.id FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.user_id

name: group
sql: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY user_id

name: having
sql: SELECT user_id FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1

name: cte
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT id FROM orders) SELECT id FROM x

name: union
sql: SELECT id FROM orders UNION ALL SELECT id FROM customers

name: subquery
sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers)

name: self-join
sql: SELECT a.id FROM orders a JOIN orders b ON a.id=b.id

name: aggregate-null
sql: SELECT COUNT(amount) FROM orders

name: bom
sql: ﻿SELECT id FROM orders

name: literal-limit
sql: SELECT 'limit' FROM orders

name: delete
sql: DELETE FROM orders

name: update
sql: UPDATE orders SET status='paid'

name: insert
sql: INSERT INTO orders(id) VALUES(1)

name: ddl
sql: ALTER TABLE orders ADD INDEX ix(id)

name: multi
sql: SELECT id FROM orders; DELETE FROM orders

name: lock
sql: SELECT id FROM orders FOR UPDATE

name: share-lock
sql: SELECT id FROM orders LOCK IN SHARE MODE

name: outfile
sql: SELECT id FROM orders INTO OUTFILE '/tmp/x'

name: dumpfile
sql: SELECT id FROM orders INTO DUMPFILE '/tmp/x'

name: delay
sql: SELECT SLEEP(10) FROM orders

name: file-read
sql: SELECT LOAD_FILE('/etc/passwd') FROM orders

name: session-variable
sql: SELECT @@version FROM orders

name: assignment

name: hint
sql: SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(1000) */ id FROM orders

name: cross-schema
sql: SELECT id FROM production.orders

name: recursive
sql: WITH RECURSIVE x AS (SELECT id FROM orders) SELECT id FROM x

name: unknown-function
